target.title: refactor(qa): unify live channel runtime hosting
target.body:
Closes #99699

## What Problem This Solves

Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp, and Matrix live QA commands each invoked their channel runtime through a separate command-owned path. Runtime construction and lifecycle hosting were therefore split even though QA Channel and Crabline already use an asynchronous factory boundary.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds one private QA SDK registry/host for asynchronous live-runtime factories, then wraps the existing Telegram, Slack, WhatsApp, and Matrix command runtimes as lazy factories in their owning plugins. The CLI commands now run through the shared host while preserving each runtime's existing credentials, scenarios, Gateway/channel startup, artifact writing, failure policy, Matrix force-exit behavior, and cleanup.

Crabline remains pinned to published 0.1.9. Its existing in-process `onEvent` observation and durable JSONL recorder are unchanged; this does not restore recorder polling or add capability metadata.

## User Impact

No production channel behavior changes. QA maintainers get one extensible runtime creation and hosting path for the four existing live channel commands, with channel-specific behavior and ownership unchanged.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugin-sdk/qa-runtime.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/live-transports/live-runtime-factories.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/cli.test.ts extensions/qa-matrix/src/cli.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/live-transports/telegram/telegram-live.runtime.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/live-transports/slack/slack-live.runtime.test.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/live-transports/whatsapp/whatsapp-live.runtime.test.ts extensions/qa-matrix/src/cli.runtime.test.ts` — 3 shards, 8 files, 227 tests passed after rebasing onto `69d4657bdb2da553641e34f1b7f85223cfb8c660`.
- Scoped `oxfmt --check`, `oxlint`, and `git diff --check` passed.
- Delegated Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwn52wf8126pgg7v50yy15wv` — full `pnpm build` and `pnpm check:changed` passed. Actions run: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28687803947
- Published `@openclaw/crabline@0.1.9` package inspection confirmed the `onEvent` observer contract; the OpenClaw consumer continues passing `onEvent` and `recorderPath` together.
- Codex autoreview on commit `4adef85d1e8190c092186e9065963682b7880f3c` — clean, no accepted/actionable findings; correctness confidence 0.93.
